name: Jakoma
audience: UK business leaders and organisations seeking evidence-led AI governance, data assurance and practical technology delivery.
objective: Develop qualified service enquiries, using the existing triage request route only after verifying current terms.
guardrails: Verify legal identity, offer, price and destination. No invented client results, professional affiliations, endorsements or guaranteed outcomes. Keep service enquiries separate from software availability.
handleStatus: existing public LinkedIn page; other channels unverified
releaseGate: Review only. Public activation requires name clearance, legal/entity confirmation and product readiness.

name: Janeomi
desc: AI marketing and commercial growth intelligence
audience: Founders, consultants, expert-led businesses and agencies without dedicated marketing expertise.
voice: Intelligent, ambitious, practical, warm and human; no hype.
objective: Validate the human-approved opportunity desk and recruit suitable supported pilot customers when access is verified.
guardrails: Private testing. No public subscription or proven sales claims without verification. Use authorised data; no unauthorised scraping, autonomous outreach or sales profiling using restricted LinkedIn data.
releaseGate: Review only. Public activation requires name clearance, legal/entity confirmation and product readiness.

name: JP Workbench
audience: UK accountants and bookkeepers; owner-managed businesses through their advisers.
objective: Validate a controlled period-close pilot and obtain consented workflow feedback.
guardrails: Private prototype. No customer financial documents in marketing inputs. Do not promise tax or accounting accuracy, automatic filing, savings or production availability. Professional review is required.
releaseGate: Review only. Public activation requires name clearance, legal/entity confirmation and product readiness.

name: Lorri-Lou’s Learning Hub
audience: Secondary learners in Northern Ireland and Norway; parents, teachers and adult supporters.

guardrails: Private build. Do not invite children's personal data, imply exam-board endorsement, guaranteed grades or verified marking accuracy. Use adult feedback and authorised educational materials.
releaseGate: Review only. Public activation requires name clearance, legal/entity confirmation and product readiness.
